**FRONTEND RULES**

CSS

- css lives in `frontend/lib/css`, base is for elements, components is for components css. each page has it's own import css file.
- a self-mounting component's css file is named after its mount id — `SHIT_1170_COMPONENT_X.css` for mount id `SHIT_1170_COMPONENT_X` — and its rules are scoped under that id, id selector first: `#SHIT_1170_COMPONENT_X .class`. a piece with no mount id of its own is named after its tsx in lower snake case, lives in `components/shared/` when many components use it and in its owner's folder when only one does, and styles itself by class only.
- a component's css file `@import`s the pieces it contains, so the page's import file lists only components. `components/shared/` css is imported by the component using it, never by the page's import file.
- the app-wide components — the loading bar, the nav and the auth button — are in `components/` itself, not in a folder. they are on every page, so their css rides along in `import.css`, the app-wide base every page links. there is no `import-app-wide.css`.

TSX

- tsx files live in `frontend/lib/components/pagefolder/`, named `<page>_<section>.tsx` after the page and the part of it they render. each one self-mounts: it renders itself into the element whose id is its mount id, and does nothing on a page that has no such element.
- reusable tsx lives in `components/shared/`, is named after what it draws, takes props, and does not self-mount.

TS

- ts lives in `frontend/lib/ts`, and important files here are the `mount_ids.ts` the `hello.ts`, and the per page `import` ts files, other page ts files are in their page subfolders
- the `import-<page>.ts` files sit at the ROOT of `frontend/lib/ts/`, one per page, and a page's html loads its own and nothing else. `import-app-wide.ts` is the shared one every page pulls in first — the network pin and the app-wide three. it, and `import-root.ts`, are the only import files that carry anything besides imports: they register the service worker.
- a page with no components of its own has no `import-<page>.css` and links the base only.

HTML

- other then the index.html all html pages live in `frontend/app`
